value.rationale: An exact matching/MaxCut structural formula for every once-subdivided finite simple graph, plus an all-coefficient polynomial and sharp census of extremal packings on full complete-graph subdivisions, provide motivated nontrivial combinatorial structure and enumeration across infinitely many natural instances. This is neither an arbitrary parameter slice nor an unsupported tiny numerical gain.
